message.content: Set up the prototype. Groups, members, habits, check-ins.

content.text: Group membership is relational (groups, members, shared habits, check-ins). Firestore makes the 'who can see which group' rules awkward. Supabase gives Postgres plus auth and row-level security per group, and the Pro plan is $25/month.

message.content: Switch to Supabase then. Also, can we keep a read-only offline cache so people can at least see today's habits without wifi?

content.text: Yes: cache the latest group state locally and queue nothing. That covers the wifi complaint for viewing at roughly a week of work.
